title: Where the Weather Answers

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A question asked over the boards is not a question put to a man. The weather answers it and the price of barley answers after it, and the row stands where it stood. What is set under wool keeps its own count; what is covered is not entered; and a thing gone around is still a thing kept.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Cross, told in the last tend of Grain

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and thirty-one to two hundred and thirty-three days, six months and fifty-one days to six months and fifty-three days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing; a plain question taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set on a seventh place with a finger between it and the sayings, the tellings and the count; the read figure held apart from the paid figure; the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no fifth telling of the burned slate, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no fourth shaping of the pot saying, no fifth witness to the question, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no opening of the widow's mark, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read, no figure given for the dressed grain or the hand that did not come back, no name spoken over the green or the shape, no sale or betrayal paid and no ending

scenes.title: The Fifty-First Day
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 231, Grain 22, Secondday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf and the Clay Yard. No recap: the hand lies down against the fold after the thirty-sixth answer and that two-rhythm coordination is set down like a tool, not recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. Two hundred and thirty-one days old, six months and fifty-one days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and withholds its fifth, its payer unnamed for two hundred and thirty-one days (T088); the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the fire's gap under the floor and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot are three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). One leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's second arithmetic and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape, and the Grain 21 question on a seventh place of its own with a finger between it and the hearings, the sayings, the tellings and the count (T101 held). Grain's second Account-day stands changed and unread under this roof; the dressed grain lies covered near the hearth with no figure over it, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost (T077). Sella comes to the fire before the basket, gives every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, water and river wind and never to the basket, says the house, keeps her half-pace from every open slate, moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning and a shelf and a basket are not openings --- no opening in fifty-one days (T058/T079/T100). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare trough, the field's empty place and the place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, each with a look and a wide step and no number --- T098 advanced, not paid (T009/T013/T092/T098). The hand is asked the first way of the chapter: up an inch toward the river's note and down at once under conditions that have sometimes answered --- the thirty-seventh answer --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named. Grain 30 (Day 239), the third and last Account-day and market, stands eight mornings ahead and is not brought early.

scenes.title: Six Counted, the Seventh Held
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 231, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. Garl is kept in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat with the crease at the left shoulder, hollow seat with its twenty-year lean, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept, a proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken two hundred and thirty-one days; no collector came up the clay road (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed and tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count; the small knife lies at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it. The ear-sentence comes to his teeth, goes all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name --- a remembered stopping and not a new one --- nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath is drawn and not spent and the loan stays uncalled; no collector came on Grain 22; chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip; keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray; three or more men went low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and get no name. He speaks to the wheel before anyone (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the burned-slate word stands at four, the shut-room tellings stay two, no fifth telling and no third, and the Grain 21 question stays on its own seventh place with no witness standing. He grows quieter and the household straightens around the quiet without an order; when Sella's voice goes low his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of her sentence, holds, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition, not a change made again, joined to no kiln (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T101 held). At the going of the light she carries him up at the half-pace, woodsmoke before and river wind behind, goes wide around every walked-around place with a look and no number, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, fold right, thread frozen; no breathing number anywhere in the house and the two rooms do not touch. Small hours: fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places; the hand is asked the second way, held to the small intake only and down before the letting go --- the thirty-eighth answer --- filed on the sixth place, not a power (T061/T082/T088).

scenes.title: What the Storing Would Take
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 232, Grain 23, Thirdday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf and the Clay Yard. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and thirty-two days old, six months and fifty-two days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and thirty-two days (T088); first smell hot clay under tallow, first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. The dressed grain is turned under its covering and looked at for damp, spread thin to finish and gathered back by the handful near the hearth; it changes state again and gains no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate (T077). A neighbour at the threshold asks what the storing will take now the grain is under wool and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere --- nothing priced, refused or entered. A wrong wind comes up off High Kiln: the sweet edge of lead glaze rides over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it, a direction and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour with no eighth (T064, T050/T051 held); one of the three shapings of the pot saying --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- is let to stand again as a saying, not a fourth likeness made a cause, with no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T061/T082). Sella moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, and leaves the widow's mark untouched --- no opening in fifty-two days, because a morning, a shelf and a yard are not openings (T058/T079/T100). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced, unpaid). The Grain 21 question is held for the afternoon and not brought early into the morning; Grain 30 (Day 239) stands seven mornings off and is not brought early. The hand is asked the third way and comes down before the counted breath --- the thirty-ninth answer --- filed on the sixth place, not a hearing or a seventh (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Question Comes Back
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 232, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MOVEMENT, advanced and not paid --- T101 gains a second hearing over the boards: a voice with no owner, no room, no hand at the kiln and no cause asks again, low into the boards and not into the basket, which row the pot went quiet on. The weather answers and the price of barley answers after it and the voice goes off up the terrace, and the row stands where it stood --- a direction arrived nowhere. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound --- what it asks, where it stands, what it would want before any man could answer it, and who would have to stand under the answer to pay for it --- and sets the second telling on the seventh place beside the first with a finger between the two, and a finger between them and the three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings of the full note and the count. Two askings are not one witness; a witness stands somewhere and can be asked, and none does. It is NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a fifth telling of the slate, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth witness --- a seed for the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked (T101 advanced, unpaid). Three sayings stay three, the burned-slate word stays at four, the shut-room tellings stay two (T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095). The afternoon thins; heat settles under the low angle into the fold where one stiff brown-edged barley crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread is frozen and unwiped; cold has stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting; Garl stays kept in objects and uncalled (T009/T013/T092). Sella moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger above the charcoal, and leaves the widow's mark untouched --- no opening in fifty-two days (T058/T079/T100). At the kindling Tarn keeps six and the seventh at the lip, stops the ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, holds nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; no collector on Grain 23; warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076/T006). At the shed Jorra parts dust from slip as clot from vessel, tells a pot You'll do, withholds the note, lets the burned-slate word stand at four and the shut-room tellings at two, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's sentence as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062). At the going of the light she carries him home at the half-pace and goes wide around the walked-around places with a look and no number; small hours with three counts in three places; hand asked the fourth way, kept to the river's own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and down on the next low note --- the fortieth answer --- filed on the sixth place, not a power (T061/T082/T088).

scenes.title: A Colour and a Shape on Separate Places
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 233, Grain 24, Fourthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf and the Clay Yard. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and thirty-three days old, six months and fifty-three days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and thirty-three days (T088); first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. Ordinary tending goes on: the dressed grain under wool is gathered back under the fold and set flat, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and given no figure (T077). A woman asks what the storing will take now the harvest is dressed and stored and is told to ask the pot; cost-questions at the door and the well go to the pot and the weather, and a fist's number come down the clay road goes back into a sleeve, arriving nowhere (T077). A wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and touches the fold and goes out on the wind --- a direction, not a second edge paid; the seventh green stays a colour and the seventh shape a shape, gathered at Grain's first market and carried unjoined through the working mornings since, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, slate or sale and no joining to the hearings or to each other, neither woman nor child called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration, no promotion into a hearing, a cause or a romance (T064, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held). Sella moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, and leaves the widow's mark untouched --- no opening in fifty-three days, because a shelf, an afternoon and a basket are not openings (T058/T079/T100/T100 held). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced, unpaid). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, tells the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count, says Yes, house to those who want the thaw early and to those who want it late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, and keeps the ear-sentence short of the calling word with nine stoppings and no tenth (T036/T076). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust and keeps the burned-slate word at four and the shut-room tellings at two; the Grain 21 question holds its two tellings on the seventh place with no witness standing (T035/T031, T101 held). Grain 30 (Day 239) stands six mornings ahead and is not brought early. The hand is asked the fifth way and comes down before the counted breath had finished --- the forty-first answer --- filed on the sixth place, not a power (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Count Goes Forward
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 233, Grain 24, Fourthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat settles under the low angle into the fold where one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lies two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread is frozen and unwiped; cold has stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat, hollow seat with its twenty-year lean, the unswept clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken two hundred and thirty-three days; no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 22, 23 or 24 (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction and tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, stands a moment counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched --- no opening in fifty-three days (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, says Six counted. The next I don't count, sets the knife at the very edge with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, holds nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; the warm stone lies cold in its loft pot (T036/T076/T006). At the shed Jorra parts dust from slip as clot from vessel, tells a pot You'll do, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, lets the burned-slate word stand at four and the shut-room tellings at two, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). At the going of the light she carries him up at the half-pace, woodsmoke before and river wind behind, goes wide around the clean dark line, the finer grey, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number; sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, fold right, thread frozen. She goes to her own bed before the small hours and leaves the coals to keep themselves; no breathing number anywhere in the house and the two rooms do not touch; fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places and none rises into another (T088, T061/T082). The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes on three places with the loft-sill scrape fourth, the carried man's pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, the returning-line place gone around with no number, and the Grain 21 question's two tellings on a seventh place of its own with nobody to own it (T101 advanced, unpaid). Nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended. The hand is asked the sixth way: up an inch toward the river's note, carried through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count has ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- the forty-second answer, a two-rhythm coordination held across the wall, remembered, not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named; not a longer reach, a miss entered, a hearing, a seventh of the full note, a tenth stopping, a payment, one of the three held changes, a key, a power or a rule. Close: two hundred and thirty-three stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and fifty-three days, told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and thirty-three days; seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape unjoined; dressed grain covered with no figure over it; the returning-line place still gone around with no number; the question standing over the boards with two askings and nobody to own it. Grain 30 (Day 239), the third and last Account-day and market, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought early. Forward into Day 234, Grain 25, Fifthday, Chapter 61.
